description: Propose a change to a protected collection in a community governed by vote (simple-majority or on-chain). The proposal's outcome is decided from voter-signed net.openfederation.governance.vote records; the proposer's seed vote produces one, and is omitted when the proposer has no repository to sign it.

errors.name: GovernanceNotActive
errors.description: Community is not using a voting governance model (simple-majority or on-chain).

errors.name: NotMember
errors.description: Caller is not a member of this community.

errors.name: CommunityMoved
errors.description: The community has moved to another PDS; this copy is read-only (#267).

errors.name: CommunityImporting
errors.description: The community is still arriving here and is not active yet (#267).

action.description: Action to perform: write or delete.

proposedRecord.description: The record to write (required for write action).
